article.title: The Role of Curiosity in Innovation
article.content: Innovation often starts with a simple question: why does this work this way? Curious people challenge assumptions and explore possibilities others ignore. They observe patterns, test ideas, and learn from failure. In teams, curiosity creates better conversations because members ask clarifying questions instead of defending fixed opinions. Companies that reward experimentation usually adapt faster to change. Curiosity does not guarantee success, but it increases the chance of discovering useful solutions.
article.translation: 创新往往始于一个简单问题：为什么它会这样运作？有好奇心的人会挑战既有假设，探索他人忽略的可能性。他们观察规律、验证想法、并从失败中学习。在团队中，好奇心能带来更高质量的讨论，因为成员更愿意澄清问题，而不是固守立场。鼓励试验的公司通常也更能适应变化。好奇心不能保证成功，但能提高找到有效解决方案的概率。
